description:

**About Us** 




 TrueBlue is the people company. We were founded on the idea that by connecting people and work, we can help our clients grow their businesses while growing ours. We have grown dramatically over the most recent years, connecting over 800,000 people with work each year while serving our clients; we have the ability and capacity to do even more. Today, our ambitious vision is to be the talent solution for the changing world of work. We see great opportunity in growing to be the leading provider of contingent workforce solutions in North America and the recruitment process outsourcing solutions globally. TrueBlue has been repeatedly recognized as one of Forbes Magazine’s “Most Trustworthy Companies” in recognition of its solid corporate governance and accounting transparency. We are committed to transparency and delivering the best financial reporting to our internal leadership and to our stockholders. We recruit strong talent that has potential to grow beyond the role initially hired and into future organizational leaders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Support Recruitment lifecycle job posting, sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer, pre\-employment checks, and onboarding activities.
* Ensure proactive candidate engagement throughout the hiring process.
* Ensure timely and accurate service delivery as per client standards
* Prompt response to queries from Internal and External stakeholders
* Update and maintain documentation along with the applicant data in ATS with accuracy.
* Works with strong process discipline and is skilled in Microsoft Office and Data Management tools. Handles ambiguity while balancing SLAs, quality, and priorities.



  





**Requirements**

* **Graduates from non\-technical backgrounds**

title: Visual Designer
description:
We're building two products under
 **ScholarAI Systems** 
 .
 



**ScholarSync** 
 is reshaping how schools, institutes, and companies deliver learning.
 



**NourishSmart** 
 is reshaping how Indian families eat and stay well.
 



  





 Two big, ambitious bets, built by a small team that moves fast and doesn't wait for permission.
 



 We need someone who can walk in and actually own the visual language of both. Not "please make this pop." Not "can you just follow the brand guide." You're building the brand guide.
 



  





**What you'll actually be doing** 



* UI/UX that people notice, wireframes to pixel\-perfect screens, systems that scale instead of falling apart the moment we ship something new
* Social creatives, decks, campaigns
* Basic motion and video work, quick edits, reels, animations, nothing that needs a full production house
* Moodboards, references, pinterest rabbit holes, the whole "why does this font feel expensive and this one feel cheap" investigation


- 


**Who we want** 



* 1\-2 years in, not a fresher, not someone who's been doing this for a decade either
* A portfolio that shows how you think, not just fifteen polished mockups with no story behind them
* Someone who researches before they design, not someone waiting for a brief to tell them what to feel
* Comfortable with basic video/motion tools
* Opinions. Actual ones. We want pushback, not "sure, whatever you think"



  





 This is a founding seat. You're not the tenth designer on a team that already decided everything. What you build now is what both brands look like a year from now and your name is on it.
 



  





 To apply, email your resume and portfolio to 
 **hr@scholaraisystems.com** 
  with '
 **Visual Designer** 
 ' in the subject line. In the body, tell us about one design, yours or someone else's, that you think is genuinely great and why.

title: Senior Executive-CRM
description:
**Job Description For RM \- CRM**
**Key purpose of the job:** 
 . To manage and analyse customer interactions and data throughout the customer lifecycle, with the goal of improving business relationships with customers, assisting in customer retention and driving sales growth. Handle customers from post sales stage till handover of the property, collection, documentation or any other paperwork on behalf of the company or the client. Compile information on customers across different channels / points of contact between the customer and the company (website, telephone, live chat, direct mail, marketing materials and social media).
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Up\-dation of data in ERP/ SAP (Sales Module).
* Managing Customer Lifecycle
* Enhance Customer Experience
* Follow\-up on submittals
* Collections/ Payment Follow Ups with Customer
* Drive post sales activity
* Address and manage escalated customer queries
* Improving business relationship with Customers \& Customer retention
* Sales \& CRM budget, MIS reports, bookings and cancellations.


**Strategic**
* Monitor and maximize customer lifetime value strategies.
* Plan \& Monitor accurate and timely sales documentation \- Eg – Application forms, Allotment Letters, Agreement for Sale / Construction, Demand Notices, Sale Deeds, Tripartite Agreements/NOC for Banks


**Operational**
* To contribute to the overall standardization of data, formats and MIS
* To conceptualize \& identify opportunities to create and implement customer delight
* Managing site visits and walk \-ins during property exhibition.
* Managing web site and walk in enquiries.
* Follow up of all walk\-in prospects and exhibition prospects and converting them to clients.
* To give product presentations and arrange site visits for clients and also accompany them to ensure better understanding of the product.
* Managing customer queries, negotiation with buyers, maintaining customer data and follow up with customers.
* Monitoring the invoices as per the site progress.
* Management of receivables, Coordination with accounts for tracking weekly and monthly collections.
* Completing formalities related to agreement and payment disbursement, Verifying agreements for registration.
* Tie up with HFIs concerning the new schemes, rate of interest, and follow up for client’s loan disbursement.
* Formulating budgets, MIS reports, bookings and cancellations.
* Updation of data in ERP/ SAP (Sales Module).
* Co\-ordination with the execution team, facility team for units to be ready for handing over possession.
* Inspecting of flats before handing over possession.
* To ensure prompt responsiveness on sales enquires (viz. customer calls, emails, walk\-ins and other correspondence) so as to maximize sales conversions
* To monitor sales collections and ensure regular follow\-up \& sending demand notices for the same – to red flag issues
* To analyze feedback from customers and the trends to sales queries and provide feedback to the Sales and Marketing teams
* To ensure complete and comprehensive documentation of all customer related records and ensure the database is centrally managed
* To ensure data entry and detailed filing of all documents received
* To ensure prompt dispatch of receipts for customer payments/ documents received
* To lead and implement ‘customer delight’ initiatives – e.g. welcome kits for new customers
* To coordinate with Legal/ Finance/ Engineering teams on customer documentation related issues


**Internal \& External Interactions**
 Internal: Engineering, Legal, Sales and Marketing, Finance, IT departments
   

  

 External: Customers, HFI Team, Bank, Agencies, Consultants
   

  

**Education \& Experience Requirement**
* Graduate/ Post Graduate/ MBA with a minimum 5\- 10 Years of Experience in real estate Sales/CRM
* Strong background in customer acquisition, re\-engagement and retention strategies.
* A Confident and articulate communicator capable of inspiring strong collaboration in the organisation

title: Store Manager
description:
\#BAL\_DTC
   

  

 We are a fun\-loving, energetic and fast growing company that breathes innovation. We strive to give an unparalleled experience to our customers and win them for life. One in every 24 people on this planet is served by Airtel. Here, we put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We encourage our people to push boundaries and evolve from skilled professionals of today to risk\-taking entrepreneurs of tomorrow. We hire people from every realm and offer them opportunities that encourage individual and professional growth. We are always looking for people who are thinkers \& doers; people with passion, curiosity \& conviction; people who are eager to break away from conventional roles and do 'jobs never done before’.
   

  

**Function:** 
 Sales
   

  

**Reporting To** 
 : Zonal Sales Manager
   

  

**Purpose of the Job**
 Located in the store, this role has direct responsibility for the successful running of the Airtel store. The person will ensure compliance with agreed guidelines to deliver a best in class experience \& ensure store revenue \& cost targets are met.
   

  

**Key Deliverables**
**Store Operations \& Audit / Compliance**
* Adherence of Store Operations in line with pre\-defined SOPs
* Ensure that the look and feel of the store is as per guidelines/standards
* Track efficient Cash handling; prevent shoplifting / ensure safety and security
* Visual merchandising as per plan / guidelines
* Inventory and stock management to prevent stock\-outs or excess Inventory
* KPI reporting as per guidelines and on\-time


**Strategic Roll Outs**
* Accountable for clearing store for formal launch as per pre\-defined procedure across dimensions (e.g. manpower/ furniture \& fittings/ IT/ device inventory)
* Manage closure of current store during refit \& conversion


**Skills Required**
* High energy
* Strong process orientation
* Project management skills
* Appreciation of need for Customer Experience delivery
* Building \& nurturing partnerships
* Influencing skills


**Profitability**
* To achieve the target on conversion from the walk in customers in terms of Sales from new acquisitions \& upsell
* To ensure required MIS \& tracking at CRO levels
* Manage Store expenses are as per plan
* Provide suggestions /feedback to improve store productivity


**People Development / Team Management**
* To ensure daily roistering \& briefing to outsourced store staff
* Ensure that attrition issues (planned \& unplanned) are escalated for timely resolution
* Ensure motivation \& development of outsourced store staff


**Customer Experience**
* Ensure adherence to CE guidelines
* Manage staff allocation based on demand at point in time
* Personally step in to handle demanding customers
* Provide suggestions for improvements in CE


**Educational Qualifications**
* Must have: Post\-graduation, MBA or equivalent Business Management Diploma


**Work Experience**
* Must have: 4\-6 years’ work experience. At least 2 years in a Retail Business operations role.

title: Admission Counsellor
description:
**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF A COUNSELLOR** 

**Attributes of a Counselor** 

* The Admission counselor should be a graduate with good communication skills in English and the regional language.
* She is the first person parents meet when they come to a EuroKids school. She should be formally dressed and presentable.
* She should be empathetic, courteous and have a professional approach while interacting with the enquiries.
* She should be aware of the product and present it in a proper sequence using simple language.
* Being alert and proactive is essential for a counselor.

**Roles and responsibilities of a counselor** 

* The counselor is responsible for the front office wherein she counsels prospective parents and maintains all the records related to enquiry.
* She should report to the school 30 minutes prior to the commencement of the first batch.
* She should be familiar with all the policies related to fee structure and admissions etc. and implement them.
* The counselor should be aware of the Happiness kit components and explain it to the parents.
* She should give a patient listening to parents.
* She should ensure that all the essentials of the waiting area should be well placed and the displays should be attractive and relevant.
* She should be responsible for the fee collection and preparation of reports pertaining to inquiries and fee payments.

**Roles and Responsibilities Post counseling** 

* Entering the details in EPMS
* Instant acknowledgement and auto generated messages are sent to parents for a few days
* EPMS entries save the counselor from additional paper work and also helps in understanding conversion rate
* Making a note of first follow\-up date
* Recording the response and action plan
* Filing the admission forms
* Convey all communications related to POP to the enquiries well in time.
* Inviting enquiries for grand celebrations like Annual Day and Sports Day etc.

**Prerequisites of counseling** 

* Reception and waiting area should be well organized with relevant information and right kind of displays.
* Work Station\- reception desk should be clutter free, all the collaterals like brochures, pamphlets and admission forms should be handy.

**While Handling Telephonic Enquiries** 

* The counselor should answer the telephone within two rings \& greet the caller.
* She should excuse herself to take the call if in the middle of a walk\-in counseling.
* She should respond well to the queries and fill up the complete details of the caller in the enquiry record book.
* She should thank the caller for calling and invite him/ her over to the school.
* She should end the call positively and let the caller hang up first.

**While Handling Walk\-in Enquiries** 

**Stage I: Meet \& Greet**

* Greet and make the parent comfortable.
* Listen to his/her queries and respond appropriately explaining about EuroKids preschools.
* Make a note of the child and parents details in the enquiry form.
* File the physical copy of enquiry form.

**Stage ll: Tour of the school**

* Start with the Reception Area, Wash Rooms, Fun Rooms, Pantry, Library, Outdoor Area etc.
* Talk about the safe environment, Fire Extinguishers, CCTV cameras, displays, group activities, usage of puppet theatres, sand \& water play areas.
* Talk about the outdoor and indoor equipment and other offerings.
* Talk about the Key Differentiators of EuroKids

**Stage Ill: Share Information** 

* Counselling Tool
* Doctor on call, Safe school certified, and First aid Box.
* Talk about in\-house training for teachers \& support staff.
* Field trips.

**Stage lV \& V: Share Fee Details \& Closure** 

* Show the approved fee structure along with the bifurcation.
* Ensure that the parent buys the admission form.
* Explain the payment terms \& conditions.
* End the conversation with a thank you and visit again note.

**While Handling Online Enquiry** 

* Conduct a telephonic enquiry
* Invite the parent for a Video conferencing session.
* Follow the process of Walk in enquiry handling.

We create technology platforms for Businesses, Smart Homes, and Internet Service Providers, driven by our goal to connect everyone, everywhere. To date, We has shipped over 100 million devices worldwide, from ISP networking products to next generation of IT solutions. Our growth is made possible by the dedicated team of hundreds behind the scenes. From software developers and product managers to designers and strategists, Team UI is driven to achieve our common goal: Rethinking IT. At organization, you’ll heighten your potential and broaden your horizons – all while shaping the future of connectivity.

About the Role

We are looking to build our Support team with highly motivated individuals who are passionate about smart home and enterprise networking technology. In this role, you will become a product expert in order to provide our global user base with the most comprehensive, efficient support possible. While many support teams focus on helping individual customers fix their problems, we prioritize using this information to improve the user experience for all customers. You will be key to advancing this user\-oriented approach to technical support. Not only will you resolve requests, but you will use the insights gained to provide product UI/UX improvements in order to reduce future request volumes. To that end, you will regularly interact with product development teams and key stakeholders— responsibilities often reserved for senior\-level engineers.

Responsibilities

**Become a product expert in designated fields such as: Wireless Technologies, Routing \& Switching, Security \& VPNs, Security Cameras, VoIP Phones, and Door Access Systems. In addition to your onboarding training, you should be proactive in reading internal product documentation, incorporating feedback from advanced technical support engineers, and performing your own independent research on our technology.** 

Be the first point of contact for our users, meeting each with a personalized action plan that not only resolves their issue, but provides a larger context of its origin and impact.

We strive to ensure that each user leaves their support interaction with a deeper understanding of their own technology.

**Obtain all necessary background information and properly qualify the nature of each support interaction. In addition to informing advanced technical support engineers, this information is vital in creating product improvements that will prevent other such requests in the future.** 

Prioritize requests based on the severity and brand liability of each UX dead\-end.

**Respond to users efficiently and insightfully to reinforce our team’s mission to provide the** best support possible.

You are not just a technical agent; you are a brand advocate, entrusted to minimize friction and maximize the positive impact of each interaction.

Every user should feel that they are being heard, that their time is valued, and that every effort is being made to resolve their issue.

Technology is inherently unpredictable, but our exemplary level of care and service should always be consistent, as this reinforces the collective trust in our brand.

**Perform hands\-on testing with provided home\-lab equipment to identify potential UX dead\-ends, reproduce known ones, and use insights from each to propose areas of improvement.** 

Stay up to date on the latest products and features, particularly those receiving a lot of attention and feedback on various social media platforms.

Knowledge and Experience

title: Walk-in || Senior Accountant
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 24 Sep - 30 Sep
Timing: 11.00 AM - 3.00 PM
Venue: H-102, MAIN MARKET, SARITA  VIHAR, NEAR POST OFFICE, 1ST FLOOR, NEW DELHI , NEAREST METRO SARITA VIHAR
Contact: ASHISH MITTAL (9810354808)

Job Description We are looking for an experienced, responsible and highly accountable Senior Accountant / Accounts In-Charge who can independently manage the day-to-day accounting, statutory compliance, banking, receivables, payables and inventory-related accounting of the company. The candidate should be hands-on, systematic, disciplined and responsible for the accuracy, completeness and timely completion of all assigned accounting work . Key Responsibilities Handle complete day-to-day accounting of the company. Prepare and file GST Returns , including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and other applicable GST compliances. Reconcile GST input/output and ensure correctness of GST records. Handle TDS calculations, deductions, payments and TDS returns . Perform daily bank reconciliation for all company bank accounts. Monitor bank entries and ensure that all receipts and payments are properly accounted for. Prepare sales invoices, tax invoices, debit notes and credit notes. Handle e-Invoicing and E-Way Bills , wherever applicable. Check invoices for correct rates, quantities, GST and other commercial details. Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. Perform regular customer and vendor reconciliation . Monitor outstanding receivables and prepare customer ageing reports. Follow up internally regarding overdue customer payments. Maintain and verify accounts payable and accounts receivable. Ensure that purchases, sales and expenses are correctly booked under appropriate accounting heads. Reconcile stock/inventory records with accounts . Verify incoming stock, purchase entries and supporting documents. Ensure that stock received is properly entered against the relevant Purchase Order / GRN / supplier invoice. Identify discrepancies between physical stock, software stock and accounting records. Maintain proper accounting records for the concerned company/business entity. Conduct ledger scrutiny and identify incorrect, duplicate or missing entries. Prepare monthly accounting reports and reconciliations. Assist in month-end and year-end closing. Coordinate with CA / auditors for GST, TDS, statutory compliance and audit requirements. Maintain complete supporting documentation and proper filing of accounting records. Ensure that statutory payments and returns are completed before their respective due dates. Daily End-of-Day Reporting Mandatory The Accounts In-Charge will be required to submit a Daily End-of-Day Accounts Report before leaving the office . The daily report should clearly mention: Bank reconciliation status. Payments received from customers. Payments made to suppliers and other parties. Customer outstanding / overdue payment status. Invoices generated during the day. Purchase entries completed. Debit notes / credit notes issued or pending. GST / TDS work completed or pending. Stock or inventory discrepancies noticed. Customer / supplier reconciliation completed. Any accounting issue, discrepancy or pending approval. Work completed during the day. Work pending at the end of the day. Reason for any pending work. Priority work planned for the next working day. No important accounting work should remain pending without being mentioned in the Daily End-of-Day Report. Accountability & Ownership This position requires a person who takes complete ownership and accountability for the assigned work . The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that: Assigned work is completed within the required timeline. Accounting entries are accurate and supported by proper documents. GST and TDS compliances are completed correctly and on time. Bank reconciliation is updated regularly. Customer outstanding is properly monitored. Customer and vendor ledgers are properly reconciled. Stock received and stock appearing in accounts/software are properly matched. Mistakes, discrepancies or missing documents are identified and reported immediately. Incorrect or incomplete information is not ignored. Pending work is reported clearly instead of being carried forward without explanation. Management is informed immediately if any issue can affect accounts, taxation, payments, customer outstanding or statutory compliance. Daily reports reflect the actual status of work and should not contain incorrect or misleading information. The employee will be accountable for the correctness and completion of the work handled by him/her and is expected to verify the work rather than simply enter data into the system. Candidate Requirements Education: B.Com / M.Com preferred. CA Inter candidates with relevant practical experience may also apply. Experience: Minimum 4–8 years of practical accounting experience . Experience in a manufacturing company will be strongly preferred. Required Skills The candidate must have good practical knowledge of: GST GSTR-1 GSTR-3B GST Reconciliation TDS TDS Returns Bank Reconciliation Accounts Receivable Accounts Payable Customer Outstanding Vendor Reconciliation Customer Reconciliation Sales Invoicing Purchase Accounting Debit Notes / Credit Notes E-Invoicing E-Way Bills Inventory / Stock Reconciliation Ledger Scrutiny Tally Prime / ERP Accounting Software MS Excel Daily MIS / Management Reporting Most Important Requirement We are looking for a person who takes ownership of the work and reports the actual position to management every day . The candidate should not merely make accounting entries. He/she must verify whether the entries, balances, invoices, bank transactions, statutory returns and stock records are correct. The person should be capable of independently identifying: What work has been completed. What work is pending. Why it is pending. What discrepancy has been found. Who needs to take action. What needs to be completed next. Preferred Candidate We prefer a candidate who is: Responsible and accountable. Detail-oriented. Strong in numbers and reconciliation. Able to work independently. Disciplined about deadlines. Regular in submitting daily reports. Good at maintaining proper documentation. Comfortable checking the work rather than simply entering data. Able to identify mistakes and resolve discrepancies. Honest and transparent in reporting. Able to take complete responsibility for assigned accounting functions. Willing to report problems immediately rather than hide or postpone them.

Key Skills: GST Return,Tally ERP,Accounts Finalisation,Bank Reconciliation,TDS Return,Book Keeping,Tally,Senior

Customer Success Executive - Personal Loan

 About the Team 
 The Personal Loans team at Navi helps customers access quick, paperless, and fully 
 digital personal loans - in a simple, fast, and transparent way. The Customer Success 
 Executive Team works like Virtual Relationship Managers focusing on helping 
 customers complete their disbursal journey through assistance and guided support over 
 phone calls. 
 About the Role 
 Your focus will be on delivering a seamless, high-quality customer experience by 
 providing tele-assistance in the loan disbursal journey. As the front line of Navis digital 
 lending experience, you will act as a brand ambassador for the company who ensures 
 that approved customers successfully complete the disbursal journey. 
 1. Customer Ownership: Proactively connect with inbound customers who have 
 loan offers and convert those leads into successful disbursals 
 2. Journey Assistance: Helping customers navigate digital journey like KYC, bank 
 mandates etc. to prevent drop-offs and contribute directly to business growth 
 3. Trust Building: Establish immediate credibility with customers, representing 
 Navis commitment to ethical and transparent lending 
 4. Problem Solving: Rapidly resolve any customer queries or technical hurdles that 
 arise during the digital application process 
 5. Customer Advocacy: Simplify complex financial terms and processes into clear, 
 actionable steps that empower the customer to move forward 
 
 
 
 Here, your voice and ideas matter. Your work makes an impact. Together you will help us 
 define the future of Navi. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Convert approved customers into disbursals through call assistance - guiding 
 them through the digital steps on the app, understanding their needs and 
 pitching Navi's offering to them accordingly 
 
 
 Respond quickly to call-back requests and ensure all leads are handled within 
 defined SLAs 
 Log, update, and follow up with customers in the CRM until the journey is 
 completed or closed 
 
 
 Explain product terms and digital steps in simple, clear language 
 Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Tech or Customer Support teams to 
 resolve blockers and improve the customer experience 
 Surface insights and feedback on why customers delay or drop off during the 
 disbursal process 
 
 Must Haves 
 
 Education: Graduate in any discipline 
 
 Experience: 1-3 years of experience in inbound telesales, or customer success, 
 or any direct customer facing role; preferably in tech or financial services. 
 Language Skills: Fluency in English and Hindi 
 Communication: Empathetic listening and clear articulation 
 Tech Readiness: Knowledge of CRM tools, dialers, and app-based journeys 
 Customer-First Mindset: Ethical, detail-oriented, and motivated to deliver a 
 high-quality customer experience 
 
 
 
 
 About Navi 
 We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion 
 Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and 
 services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI. 
 Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of Indias 
 fastest-growing financial services organisations. But were just getting started! 
 Our Culture 
 At Navi, were a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact 
 quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to 
 solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an 
 environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating 
 learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether youre shaping the future of 
 fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part 
 of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a 
 difference. 
 Were guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape

The Role In this role, you will uncover the insights and intelligence that help customers in dynamic, dataintensive industries operate, scale, and innovate. You will develop robust, futureready machine learning and analytical models that enable predictive insights, automation, and datadriven decision making across complex digital transformation programmes. With access to modern data platforms, highquality datasets, and advanced statistical and AI frameworks, you will work closely with engineering, product, and analytics teams to build solutions that are accurate, explainable, and scalable. This role empowers you to shape endtoend analytical ecosystemsaccelerating delivery, enhancing decision quality, strengthening operational resilience, and guiding organisations toward a more insightrich, AIenabled future. Your responsibilities: (Up to 10, Avoid repetition) Explore, clean, and analyse large, complex datasets to uncover patterns, trends, and opportunities that drive actionable insights. Develop, train, and validate machine learning, statistical, and predictive models that solve real business problems and deliver measurable impact. Design and run experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis tests, simulations) to evaluate ideas, quantify outcomes, and guide decisionmaking. Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, product managers, and domain experts to translate business requirements into welldefined modelling tasks. Build endtoend ML pipelines—from feature engineering and preprocessing to deploymentready model outputs. Apply advanced techniques such as NLP, timeseries forecasting, anomaly detection, optimisation, or LLM/GenAI methods where relevant. Implement model evaluation frameworks using offline metrics, crossvalidation, online experiments, and humanintheloop feedback loops. Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, visualisations, written summaries, and presentations tailored to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Ensure models are interpretable and explainable where required, providing transparency into key drivers and assumptions. Work with engineering teams to deploy models into production, monitor performance, and retrain or recalibrate as data and conditions change. Your Profile Essential skills/knowledge/experience: (Up to 10, Avoid repetition) Role- Data Scientist ( 5 to 12 Yrs ) Hands-on experience with GenAI, Gemini or Open source LLMs and develop GenAI applications for Code Translation, Text Extraction, Summarisation and SDLC Optimization etc. Hands-on Experience with AI Agents, Chat bots, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and vector databases. ( PG vector / croma DB ) Hands-on Experience with GenAI Performance Evaluation tools like Pegasus, Ragas, DeepEval Create Conversational Interface with React JS or other Frontend components, Develop and deploy AI agents using LangGraph and ADK, A2A, MCP Strong programming skills in Python (experience with LangChain/LangGraph / LangSmith frameworks) and TypeScript ( preferable ) Solid understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, and graph-based workflows. Knowledge and implementation of Input and Output guardrails in addressing Hallucination, PII filtering, HAP and Bias etc. Implemented security best practices, Experience to address spikes and Denial of wallet attacks, DDoS attack and other Spike arrest strategies Knowledge of API Gateways and ISTIO , ability to Diagnose and intercept failures in End to End communication Hands-on Experience with API Development and Microservices architecture Desirable skills/knowledge/experience: (As applicable) Strong experience applying machine learning, statistical modelling, and predictive analytics to realworld business problems. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ability to resolve end to end connectivity and Data Integrations Experience working with large, complex datasets, including data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis. Familiarity with LLMs, NLP techniques, and GenAI frameworks, including embeddings, prompt engineering, or finetuning. Experience building endtoend ML pipelines, including model validation, optimisation, deployment, and monitoring. Understanding of MLOps practices, including model versioning, model registries, CI/CD for ML, and automated training/inference workflows. Ability to translate business problems into analytical tasks and communicate insights in a clear, concise manner to technical and nontechnical audiences. Knowledge of data governance, including data quality, lineage, ethics, privacy considerations, and responsible AI principles. Comfort working with cloud platforms (GCP preferred) for model training, deployment, and scalable compute. A growthoriented mindset with enthusiasm for exploring new algorithms, tools, and emerging AI/ML techniques

 Architect third-party integrations with CRM, ERP, DAM, PIM, Payment Gateways, and Analytics platforms. Stakeholder Engagement & Problem Solving:

Optimizely Expertise: Proven experience architecting solutions on Optimizely CMS / Episerver (preferably v12+ on .NET Core) and familiarity with Optimizely DXP deployment models. Backend Proficiency: Deep hands-on mastery of C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API , Entity Framework, and cloud-native microservice architecture. Frontend Mastery: Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and Vue.js (Vue 2/3, Vuex/Pinia, SSR with Nuxt.js) . Integrations & APIs: Proven track record in API-first design using REST, GraphQL , and asynchronous messaging/queues. Cloud & DevOps: Direct experience with Microsoft Azure , Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and CDN/Caching configurations (Cloudflare/Akamai). Database & Data Modeling: Expert knowledge of SQL Server , database indexing, caching strategies (Redis), and data architecture for high-traffic sites.
